document.title: Reap finished upload handler threads so the listener keeps accepting
document.summary: The Runtime Upload listener now joins finished handler threads before admitting new clients. The Shell now consumes the last upload message instead of re-reading it every frame.
document.why: [The Runtime Upload listener stops accepting after 16 connections](source:s1), and browsers reach that limit in normal use.

sources.title: [Claude] Runtime Upload listener stops accepting after 16 connections
sources.gist: handler_count only grows, so the 17th connection is shut down; reap finished handlers and clear last_message after the Shell reads it.

sources.title: fix(upload): reap finished handler threads so the listener keeps accepting
sources.gist: Handler slots with a done flag, joined in the accept loop; take-style message API.

groups.title: Handler slots and reaping
groups.why: [Handler threads were only joined at stop](source:s1), so the fixed 16-entry handler array filled up for good.
groups.summary: `handler_thread` marks its `VdUploadHandler` slot done under the mutex, and `server_thread` calls `reap_finished_handlers` to join done slots before choosing a free slot for the next client.
lookFor: Subtle: a handler can set `done` before `server_thread` stores its `thread` pointer. That is safe because only `server_thread` reads or writes `.thread` and reaps on its next accept.
Finished handlers stay unjoined until the next `accept` or `upload_server_stop`, so at most 16 exited threads wait to be joined while the listener is idle.
When all 16 slots hold live clients, a new connection is closed without a response, as it was before.

groups.title: Shell consumes the upload message
groups.why: [Clear `last_message` after the Shell reads it](source:s1), so the upload message stops overwriting later Shell messages every frame.
groups.summary: `upload_server_last_message` becomes `upload_server_take_message`, which clears the message and returns whether there was one. `shell_update` copies the message only when that call returns true.

commits.subject: fix(upload): reap finished handler threads so the listener keeps accepting
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Handlers mark their slot done under the server mutex; the accept loop joins
done handlers before admitting a new client, so VD_UPLOAD_MAX_OPEN_CLIENTS
caps concurrent clients instead of connections per session.

The Shell now takes the last upload message instead of re-reading it every
frame, so later Shell messages are no longer overwritten.

Fixes #41
